header.running_head: Learning, Teaching and Rehearsing the Knowledge of Deen and Questions that are Appropriate and those that are Inappropriate

blocks.text: Statements of Hadhrat Abu Sa'eed (RA), Hadhrat Ali (RA), Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) and Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) Concerning Rehearsing what was Learnt

Hadhrat Abu Nadhra says that when they once requested Hadhrat Abu Sa'eed Khudri (RA) to write down Ahadeeth for them, he said, "I shall never write it for you and never make it like the Qur'aan. You should learn the Ahadeeth from us as we had learnt from Rasulullaah ﷺ (by memory and not in writing)." Hadhrat Abu Sa'eed Khudri (RA) also used to say, "Rehearse the Ahadeeth amongst yourselves because this reinforces the memory." [^2]
Another narration quotes Hadhrat Abu Sa'eed Khudri (RA) as saying, "Rehearse the Ahadeeth amongst yourselves because this rejuvenates the memory." [^3]

Hadhrat Ali (RA) said, "Rehearse the Ahadeeth amongst yourselves because if you do not do this, you will forget them." [^4] Another narration states that Hadhrat Ali (RA) also added, "Keep visiting each other." [^5]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) said, "Rehearse the Ahadeeth amongst yourselves because this keeps it alive." [^6] Another narration quotes Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) as saying, "Rehearsing (Deeni knowledge and the Ahadeeth) reaps the reward of (Nafl) salaah." [^7]
Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) said, "I prefer rehearsing the knowledge of Deen for a part of the night to engaging in Ibaadah throughout the night." [^8]
Hadhrat Umar (RA) asks Hadhrat Ali (RA) Three Question and is Overjoyed with the Replies

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) narrates that Hadhrat Umar (RA) once addressed Hadhrat Ali (RA) saying, "O Abul Hasan! There were times when you were present with Rasulullaah ﷺ when we were not and there were times when we were present with Rasulullaah ﷺ when you were not. I have three questions to pose to you. Do you know anything about them?" "What are they?" Hadhrat Ali (RA) asked. Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "(Is it possible that) A man likes another when he has seen no good in him or dislikes a man when he has seen no bad in him?" "That is certainly possible," Hadhrat Ali (RA) replied, "Rasulullaah ﷺ once said, 'All souls had been gathered together in metaphysical realm where they met and associated.
